verses.1: And if a person sins, and he hears that voice, whether he sees it or knows about it, but doesn’t tell anyone, then he will be punished.
verses.2: Or a soul that touches everything that is impure or filthy. It’s like touching something that’s filthy, or something related to animals that are impure, or something related to animals that are dirty. Such a soul will disappear from sight. It’s impure and worthless.
verses.3: For when a person is covered in shame, all the shame that he bears will be hidden from him. And he will know and understand it.
verses.4: Oh soul, if you will truly live by speaking the truth, whether for good or for evil. Or if you will do what is right for everyone who does what is right. Then you will be remembered among them, and you will be known as one of them.
verses.5: And it shall be that one of them will be punished, and the woman who has sinned against her will also be punished.
verses.6: And he shall bring his sins before Jehovah for his sin. He has sinned in a manner that is worse than any other sinner. The priest will condemn him to punishment for his sin.
verses.7: And if his hands do not reach down and bring back the sins that two men of Zion have committed—one for sin, and one for punishment.
verses.8: And he brought them before the priest, and offered up what was to be offered as atonement for their sins. He cut off their heads from above their shoulders, and he did not spare them at all.
verses.9: And this blood of sin is applied to the walls of the altar. The blood that remains there will be brought before the altar as a symbol of sin.
verses.10: And the second one will be forgiven, according to the law. The priest will forgive him for his sins.
verses.11: And if he does not bring his hands to the two lambs or to the two sons of Jona, and if he does not bring his sin offering, which is the lamb that was taken in sacrifice for sin, then it shall not be placed on it any ointment, nor shall it be used as food. For it is a sin.
verses.12: And she brought it to the priest. The priest then tasted it from it; it was considered an offering of guilt. Then the altar was lit on the fire of Jehovah. This was an act of sinning.
verses.13: And the priest shall take responsibility for his sin. He has committed a sin against one of them, but he will be forgiven. Then the priest will be like a priest who has been forgiven for his sins.
verses.14: And Jehovah spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.15: The soul that transgresses and sins in ignorance against the holy things of Yahweh, and brings its sins before Yahweh… It’s like a pure lamb from the flock, valued at its weight in silver coins, according to the sacred value.
verses.16: And he who has sinned against the Holy One will be forgiven. His sins will be forgiven, and he will be given back to the priest. The priest will burn him on the altar, and he will be forgiven.
verses.17: And if a person sins and violates one of Jehovah’s commandments, which they should not violate or know about, then they will be punished and brought before the Lord.
verses.18: And he shall bring the pure lambs from the flock, in their proper order, to the priest. The priest will judge him according to his sin. He has sinned, but he does not know it. So, he will be forgiven.
verses.19: He is a sinner, a sinner who deserves punishment from Jehovah.
verses.20: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying:
verses.21: One’s soul will be condemned when one sins and transgresses against God. One will also be considered a liar by his fellow humans, either in times of need or during times of exploitation or oppression against his neighbors.
verses.22: Or, he finds a dead body, and in it there is nothing but deceit. And he will be praised for lying against one of the things that people do in their sins.
verses.23: And it shall be as if there was a sin and a corruption; and the thief who stole will be returned, or the one who covered up will be brought back, or the one who supervised will be restored to his position, or the dead will be brought back to life.
verses.24: Or, from all those things that are praised for their falsehoods, and he is still considered good in his own way. His five sons also benefit from this, since they were given to him on the day of his punishment.
verses.25: And they shall bring their sins before Jehovah. They shall bring the sheep from the flock, according to their sins, to the priest.
verses.26: And the priest shall offer a sacrifice before Jehovah, and he shall be forgiven for all that he has done to the offender.
